mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, email, nickname, avatar, role, status, locale, last_login_ip, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, username, password, phone, email, nickname, avatar, role, status, locale, last_login_ip, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, phone, email, nickname, avatar, role, status, locale) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{role}, #{status}, #{locale})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET role = #{role} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, email, nickname, avatar, role, status, locale, last_login_ip, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE avatar IS NOT NULL AND avatar != ''
